name: List contact timeline event filters
description: Call this when you need the set of event sources and event types that are valid filter values for a contact's activity timeline — for example before narrowing a timeline query to CRM meetings, phone calls, or transactional email events. It returns the filter vocabulary only, not any contact's events; to read the events themselves use the contact timeline/activity listing action, and to look up a contact's identity or attributes use the contact detail action instead.
preconditions: The account (organization) identified by the path id must exist and the caller must be authenticated for it.
The caller's session must have access to the contacts module of that account.

id.description: Account (organization) identifier whose contact timeline filter vocabulary is requested; appears as :id in the path and matches the ACCOUNT_ID in the app route.

data.description: Available filter groups, one per event source.

source.description: Machine identifier of the event source, e.g. "Meetings", "Phone", "google_calendar_sales", "transactional". Use this value when filtering a timeline by source.

label.description: Display label for the source as shown in the UI; may differ from source (e.g. source "transactional" has label "email_transactional").

related_chips.description: Product-area tags the source is grouped under in the UI, e.g. ["crm"] or ["marketing"]; null when the source has no grouping.

is_unified.description: Whether the source is part of the unified timeline. Absent on some sources.

events.description: Event types selectable within this source.

type.description: Machine identifier of the event type, e.g. "meeting_booked", "call_finished", "open". Use this value when filtering a timeline by event type.

label.description: Display label for the event type.
